name: Lisbon
about: Summer is warm/dry and busy, spring and fall are mild and quieter, winter is mild but wetter.
overview: Hillside pastel-colored streets, vintage trams, and a laid-back Atlantic-coast capital.
costOverview: Coffee, pastries, and the iconic trams all cost next to nothing — one of Western Europe's most affordable capitals.
